author: Chau Nguyen; Son Nguyen; Dora Woodruff
work: Shuffle Tableaux, Littlewood–Richardson Coefficients, and Schur Log-Concavity

difficulty_reason: After the reproduced tableau and lowering-operator definitions are allowed, the current author proof still establishes a coupled algorithm/inverse theorem. It proves highest-weight validity by non-overlapped reading-word counts, proves inverse column strictness by a lowering contradiction, and proves inverse D-compatibility by eliminating k>2 and separate maximal-violation k=2 and minimal-violation k=1 configurations. All those source arguments are retained. This is a nonroutine constraint-preserving bijection with inverse, not evaluation of a standard formula, and the four helper lemmas form one H2 target rather than four counts.
